title: Graduate Fellowship Program
institution: Kavli Institute for Theoretical Physics (KITP), UC Santa Barbara
about: KITP's Graduate Fellowship Program hosts graduate students for 5-6 month appointments. For the summer/fall (July-December) term, applications or nominations must be received by 15 February. Applicants send a CV and a 500-word essay; the advisor provides a recommendation letter.
